dct_creator_sm: Fortin, Marcel (University of Toronto). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0722-4405
dct_description_sm:
Historical streetcar routes in Toronto from 1861 - 1961. This includes the route, the route name, the date the route started, the date the route ended, the type of service provided, service hours, notes on the route, a route ID, the decade a route started, the length of the route, the owner of the route, and the sector the route was in (public or private). Includes streetcars, radials, and the Belt Line railway.

Date of creation: 2015 - 2016

Projection: NAD83 UTM Zone 17

Data type: Vector
